execution_closure_compliance.completed_bar_semantics: 1m DualEma completed bars for regime direction; 5s completed bars for evaluation grid
execution_closure_compliance.atr_initialization: Regime start ATR initialized from completed 1m ATR at regime_start_ts
execution_closure_compliance.tie_breaking_rules: Timestamp tie-breaking preserves chronological event order (NEW_MAX -> PULLBACK -> RECOVERY -> ROLLOVER -> FLIP)

current_pullback_atr.update_event: 5s bar close during active pullback (giveback >= 0.50 ATR)
current_pullback_atr.reset_semantics: Resets to 0 on NEW_MAX_MFE or regime flip

prior_peak_mfe_atr.update_event: Emitted when price reaches new peak MFE (cur_mfe > running_max_mfe)
prior_peak_mfe_atr.timestamp_semantics: Timestamp of most recent peak MFE prior to or at current bar

is_pb05.update_event: Binary indicator whether current giveback >= 0.50 ATR
is_pb05.reset_semantics: Resets on new max MFE or regime flip

is_pb10.update_event: Binary indicator whether current giveback >= 1.00 ATR
is_pb10.reset_semantics: Resets on new max MFE or regime flip

is_pb15.update_event: Binary indicator whether current giveback >= 1.50 ATR
is_pb15.reset_semantics: Resets on new max MFE or regime flip

is_pb20.update_event: Binary indicator whether current giveback >= 2.00 ATR
is_pb20.reset_semantics: Resets on new max MFE or regime flip

direction.update_event: Dual EMA crossover on completed 1m bar

current_recovery_fraction.update_event: When price rebounds from deepest pullback in episode
current_recovery_fraction.reset_semantics: Resets to 0.0 when new deepest pullback is made in episode

max_recovery_fraction_so_far.update_event: Highest recovery fraction achieved within the current bounce leg
max_recovery_fraction_so_far.reset_semantics: Resets to 0.0 on rollover to new deepest pullback

episode_max_recovery_fraction.update_event: Highest recovery fraction achieved across all bounces in episode
episode_max_recovery_fraction.reset_semantics: Resets to 0.0 on new max MFE / episode start
required_historical_state: all bounce recovery values in episode

recovery_rollover_count.update_event: Increments when a recovery leg (>= 25%) fails and makes a new low
recovery_rollover_count.timestamp_semantics: ts_init of completed 5s bar breaking deepest pullback
recovery_rollover_count.reset_semantics: Resets to 0 on new max MFE / episode start

has_prior_recovery_ge25_num.update_event: Latches True (1.0) when any recovery in episode reaches >= 25%

has_prior_recovery_ge50_num.update_event: Latches True (1.0) when any recovery in episode reaches >= 50%

has_prior_recovery_ge75_num.update_event: Latches True (1.0) when any recovery in episode reaches >= 75%

is_rollover_ge25_num.update_event: True (1.0) at the observation where a >= 25% recovery fails into new low

is_rollover_ge50_num.update_event: True (1.0) at the observation where a >= 50% recovery fails into new low

is_rollover_ge75_num.update_event: True (1.0) at the observation where a >= 75% recovery fails into new low

is_recovering.reset_semantics: Updated tick-by-tick upon price direction changes

is_deteriorating.update_event: True (1.0) when price is at new deepest pullback without active recovery
is_deteriorating.reset_semantics: Updated tick-by-tick upon price direction changes

is_rollover.update_event: True (1.0) at the exact transition where price breaks below prior deepest pullback

regime_age_seconds.update_event: Evaluated at each transition observation: (t - regime_start_ts) / 1e9
regime_age_seconds.timestamp_semantics: ts_init of completed 5s bar vs regime start timestamp

seconds_since_peak_mfe.update_event: Evaluated at each transition observation: (t - running_max_mfe_ts) / 1e9
seconds_since_peak_mfe.timestamp_semantics: ts_init of completed 5s bar vs running peak MFE timestamp
seconds_since_peak_mfe.reset_semantics: Resets to 0 whenever new peak MFE is established

seconds_since_deepest_pullback.update_event: Evaluated at each transition observation: (t - deepest_pb_ts) / 1e9
seconds_since_deepest_pullback.timestamp_semantics: ts_init of completed 5s bar vs deepest pullback timestamp
seconds_since_deepest_pullback.reset_semantics: Resets to 0 whenever a new deepest pullback is set

pullback_to_prior_peak_ratio.update_event: Evaluated at each observation: current_pullback_atr / prior_peak_mfe_atr
pullback_to_prior_peak_ratio.reset_semantics: Recomputed at each observation; resets on episode end
